text.p: Struggling English premier league side Middlesbrough have added another Brazilian to their ranks by signing Emerson's cousin Fabio on a free contract.
The midfielder went to Middlesbrough in November to visit Emerson, who joined the club from Portuguese champions Porto last year for 4.0 million pounds ($6.5 million).
Fabio took part in a training session and, after impressing manager Bryan Robson, played in a reserve game for the club, currently bottom of the table.
He holds a Portuguese passport so does not need a work permit to play in England.
Middlesbrough fans have delivered 18,500 signed postcards to the English F.A. in protest at the docking of three points for unilaterally postponing a match at Blackburn in December.
